D20_A.name: Category-Aware Options Quality Gate
D20_A.rule: breakout > 0 AND volume > 0 for STOCK_OPTIONS and INDEX_OPTIONS; fail-closed; EQUITY_SWING_DELIVERY 100% unaffected
D20_A.unit_test_coverage: 10 dedicated unit tests + 2 integration tests (100% pass)

D20_B.name: Canonical Index Options Session Deduplication
D20_B.rule: Max 1 CALL + 1 PUT per canonical index underlying per trading session (IST); CALL + PUT coexist; midnight rollover resets quota
D20_B.unit_test_coverage: 6 dedicated unit tests + 1 integration test (100% pass)

D20_C.name: Experimental Target Model Scaffolding
D20_C.rule: Production path remains strictly +4% T1, +8% T2, -3% SL; experimental +1.2%/+2.4%/-1.0% hard-disabled from production runtime

incident_investigation.cause: Diagnostic terminal execution of AllNSEScanner._dispatch_alert_if_eligible without mocking tracker persistence wrote 1 diagnostic signal
incident_investigation.impact_on_tests: signal_forward_observations increased from 101 to 102, causing 2 G4 analytics regression tests to fail assertion (expected 101, got 102)
incident_investigation.action_taken: Immediate stop under Section 6 & 11; no unauthorized row deletion or repair attempted; reporting exact state for operator decision
